_comment: ADO test plan/suite registry for `npm run fetch`. Key = VUCEM procedure code, value = its ADO test-suite id (or an object {"suite": id, "plan": id} to override the default plan). `plan` below is the shared default. Add one line per procedure so `npm run fetch -- <code>` resolves the suite itself — no --suite/--plan needed. CLI flags still override; .env is the last-resort fallback.
